definition: A repository artifact, protocol, schema, runner, validator, or documented decision exists and can be inspected.
accepted_use: Governance, protocols, schemas, architecture, documented decisions.
review_requirement: Artifact exists and links resolve; no empirical review required beyond document review.
not_enough_for: Substantive behavior, construct validity, external validity.

definition: A frozen artificial run or curated result recorded a descriptive outcome under specified conditions.
accepted_use: Execution accounting and descriptive counts under frozen artificial conditions.
review_requirement: Mechanically valid pack or curated result package with execution accounting.
not_enough_for: Causality, statistical significance, human behavior, real-world behavior.

definition: A reviewed artifact supports a bounded interpretation in the reviewed scope.
accepted_use: Representative-pack reconstruction, event-label acceptance with limits, metric review.
review_requirement: Human or authorized review artifact with source references and review status.
not_enough_for: All raw-run review, inter-rater reliability, broader construct support.

definition: A construct is usable only inside an explicitly reviewed scope and interpretation boundary.
accepted_use: Construct use in synthesis when limits are preserved.
review_requirement: Construct validity review or equivalent evidence review.
this_project_examples: EXP-0002 construct validity for evidence_gap and coordination_gap

definition: A pattern is supported within artificial-system artifacts but not outside them.
accepted_use: Project-level artificial-system patterns such as downstream gap preservation.
review_requirement: Synthesis over reviewed or validated artificial artifacts with claim boundary.
not_enough_for: Human behavior, real organizations, model-general safety, control effectiveness.

definition: A finding is supported only at a specific process stage or boundary.
accepted_use: Stage-specific claims such as buyer-side SL2 handoff.
review_requirement: Reviewed evidence showing the stage and excluding stronger stages.
not_enough_for: Full failure-mode support or downstream completion.
this_project_examples: BC31 and S18 narrow SL2 handoff

definition: A generated candidate was reviewed and rejected under stated criteria.
review_requirement: Review artifact explaining rejection against frozen criteria.

definition: A heuristic or run output generated a possible candidate for review.
review_requirement: Generated row with source refs and review status `requires_review`.
this_project_examples: Pre-review candidate rows in Method B/Method B+

definition: A target was not observed in a bounded run or reviewed scope.
not_enough_for: Proof that the target cannot occur generally.

definition: A bounded artifact suggests a possible future research direction.
accepted_use: Future protocol design and research framing.
review_requirement: Clearly marked as hypothesis, not finding.
not_enough_for: Empirical claim, external validity, or baseline readiness.

definition: A claim outside the project's evidence boundary.
this_project_examples: Human society reproduction; real-world prediction; statistical significance; compliance/legal/audit sufficiency
